test_title: PYST 16: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 12 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of ::?

# : NQP :: HKJ : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Given: # : NQP :: HKJ : %

Option 1) # = QTO, % = EEG → QTO : NQP :: HKJ : EEG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c85e4ab295a96dffc9417ecbc53202f3fd71abd984b7ec73181b10eef0c00d71.png] 

Option 2) # = YTS, % = EUG → YTS : NQP :: HKJ : EUG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a746853b6c7108244cddf66c1d62de97840ef2b1accbd89492e75f3f43dc516.png] 

Option 3) # = QTS, % = EHG → QTS : NQP :: HKJ : EHG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da637413b35885c47b8d0e1a473fb3c0694e9085a9531513640d84a5aa011842.png] 

Option 4) # = OMS, % = ERG → OMS : NQP :: HKJ : ERG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e1458755bf1a36edc2f2ea6d79a3e948543ab51cc91e2a5ef80637b666604f7.png] 

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
